title: Hasselback Potatoes
description: Fanned potatoes basted twice in garlic butter — crisp edges, soft centre.

ingredients.note: Maris Piper, King Edward, Desiree, Yukon Gold or russet all work

ingredients.item: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.do: Heat the oven to 200°C / 400°F. Line a baking tray with parchment or grease it.
Scrub the potatoes under cold water and dry them.

Working one at a time on a board, hold a potato between thumb and finger and cut crosswise slices about 4 mm apart, stopping short of the base so the slices stay joined. Laying chopsticks along both sides makes this foolproof — the blade stops on the wood.
Set the potatoes on the tray, cut side up.
Melt the butter and chop the parsley.
Stir the oil, melted butter, garlic paste, salt and pepper together in a small bowl. Hold back roughly half for later.
uses: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.do: Brush the mixture over each potato, pushing it down into the cuts. Bake 40 minutes.
Pull the tray out, baste with the reserved garlic butter, and return to the oven for a further 15–20 minutes, until cooked through and crisp at the edges.
Scatter with parsley and serve hot.

notes: Slice slowly. No fast fingers — the whole thing depends on not cutting through the base.
Skip garlic granules. They scorch over an hour in the oven and turn the dish bitter. Paste or powder only.
Size matters. Medium potatoes cook in the stated time; large ones will need longer.
Seasoning variations. Rosemary, smoked paprika or oregano all suit the butter.
Cheese. Tuck grated cheddar or mozzarella into the cuts near the end — wrap each potato in foil first, or it runs everywhere.
The oil looks like a lot. It is, but most of it stays on the tray rather than in the potato.
Storing. Cool completely, then refrigerate. Reheat 10 minutes at 170°C / 340°F, or use an air fryer — faster and crisper.
nutrition: Per serving (estimate): 471 kcal · 60 g carbs · 7 g protein · 24 g fat (19 g sat) · 7 g fibre · 1431 mg potassium · 71 mg sodium

source.name: Ájọkẹ, “Hasselback Potatoes Recipe,” The Dinner Bite
